stopping_rule: User-imposed elapsed-time cap supersedes ten-attempt target. Stop new decision submissions at collection cutoff; preserve incomplete runs. Complete review and publication by delivery deadline, or finish sooner if no useful authorized work remains.
launch_rule: Start another context only while remaining collection minutes are at least the fixed model-specific allowance; never use effects or p-values to choose whether to start.
scientific_changes: None to prompts, requested model/high effort, physics, choices, or endpoints. Sampling/stopping amended prospectively after interim descriptive results were seen; inference remains exploratory.
inference: No significance guarantee. Keep null/opposite/excluded/incomplete attempts. Use all completed reviewed contexts at the fixed time cutoff; retain Holm20 family. Chain prefixes remain descriptive.
previous_target_status: Ten attempts per model is superseded, not a completion requirement.
